Thank you for caring, Tita! I checked: the tea has no FDA registration and the page is a seller. Lola, please keep taking your medicine, and let us ask Kuya Jun first.
Warm first, then facts, a source and a next step. Kindness keeps the family listening.
Share the tea post again with "FAKE" on top

Sorry, I only reacted because I love you all. Lola, please talk to Kuya Jun before you stop any pills.

Check it now, then post a kind correction in both groups

Say nothing. It will blow over

Sorry Tita, I was harsh. Thank you for caring! I looked it up: no FDA registration. Let us ask Kuya Jun together.

Check it together: who posted it, then the FDA portal
Let us check it together. Who posted it? Is it on the FDA list?

You checked first and answered kindly. Lola keeps taking her medicine, Kuya Jun will check her blood sugar at the health center, and Tita feels proud she started the talk.

Next time I will check first too. Thank you, okay? ❤️
Family's Light! You were warm and you were right.
A close call
The family got the right facts in the end, but not everyone was spared. Someone felt hurt, or a few people saw the fake first. A kinder, earlier check would have been smoother.
Good that we caught it. Lola, please do not stop any medicine. Visit me at the health center.
Ate, next time check first, then reply. 😅
So close to perfect! Pause, check, then reply kindly.
The ripple grows
The fake kept going. Lola started the tea and skipped her pills. Kuya Jun noticed during a house visit and took her to see a doctor. She is okay, but it did not need to happen.
Lola, please never stop your medicine without your doctor. Let us go to the health center now.
Oh, sorry, dear. I thought it was safe.
It is not your fault, friend. Let us try again: pause, check, reply kindly.
Share Before It Is Deleted
Family GC, late evening
It has no author, no date, no source, a copied city name and a deadline. The deadline is the trick: it pushes you to share before you check.
CONTENT_GUIDE section 4 (Fear Monger): a strong feeling and a deadline are the cue to pause and check; real alerts come from official pages.
URGENT!!! NEW KILLER FEVER in our city! Hospitals are FULL and HIDING the numbers! SHARE to 10 groups before they DELETE this!!! 😱
Please everyone, stay safe!
Oh no, should I tell my classmates? Should the kids stay home tomorrow?
Everyone is scared. What do you do first?
React with 😱
Panic spreads fast. Your reaction tells Bea this is serious and true.
Check who posted it and when
Wait, who wrote this? Is there a date?
Pausing is Step 1, and asking who said it is Step 2. Nicely done.
Author
None. It says "forwarded many times".
Date
No date. The same text went around last year with a different city name.
Style
ALL CAPS, many "!!!" and "share before it is deleted"
A copied chain message. Fear and a deadline are the trick.
Look on the DOH official page
Let me check the DOH official page first.
Going to the official page yourself is the best "another source" check.
DOH official page
The DOH official page and your health center notice board

Advice there
